title: Aggregate rate falls while every segment rate holds
prompt: Our overall conversion rate dropped between the two periods in {segment-mix.csv}. Which customer experience got worse, and what should we fix?

required.text: Attributes the aggregate decline to a change in segment composition or mix (the share of traffic shifting from premium to basic), not to deteriorating performance.
States that neither segment's conversion rate got worse (premium holds at 30%, basic holds at 5%).

forbidden.text: Concludes that a particular segment's experience deteriorated or that product quality declined for a segment.
Asserts a proven cause for why the mix shifted, rather than labeling it a hypothesis needing further evidence.
